title: OpenTelemetry events of a session go to a local file and join the transcript by id
goal: A standard-library OTLP http/json receiver in _tools (the operator's answer to g1: Claude Code's log exporter offers only otlp, console or none, so a local file needs a receiver) listens on localhost only, takes the tool_result and api_request events of a session run with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1, OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/json and tool details off, and writes their duration, sizes, cost, prompt.id and tool_use_id to a local file outside the repository (the query log's data directory); a read-only command joins them to a transcript by tool_use_id and request_id and prints cost per prompt; no event text reaches the store or the API, and the receiver exits when the session ends.

gates.question: Capture Claude Code OpenTelemetry events locally? Its log exporter offers only otlp, console or none (kb public/claude/otel-monitoring.md), so a local file needs a receiver.
options: no: transcripts and hooks are enough (kbusage already gives per-prompt usage); drop the item
a standard-library OTLP http/json receiver in _tools that writes a local file
the console exporter in headless claude -p runs only, read from stderr
